title: DOW-UAP-D42, Range Fouler Debrief, Japan, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a declassified U.S. Navy Range Fouler Debrief Form detailing a 2020 UAP sighting by a pilot, containing significant redactions under 1.4(a) and other privacy/security exemptions.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military pilot observed three unidentified objects moving amongst each other on a sensor screen during an ISR mission.
incidents.quote: Saw the initial object fly through the screen and started tracking it.
